title.ja: 倍になった値札と、消えた鍵の噂
title.en: A Doubled Price Tag and Rumors of a Lost Key

excerpt.ja: 金貨二枚。それが、あの青い石の首飾りの新しい値段。
excerpt.en: Two gold coins. That is the new price for the blue stone necklace.

mood.ja: 鍵を失くした師匠の噂と、一向に貯まらない頭金への焦燥
mood.en: Anxiety over the rumor of my master losing his key and the down payment that just won't accumulate.

title.ja: 削られた刻印と逆打ちの座金
title.en: Scraped Marks and the Reversed Washer

excerpt.ja: 師匠の過去の誤りと、兄の持ってきたこの燭台の繋がりについて、確証を得るには至らない。
excerpt.en: I cannot establish a definitive connection between my master's past error and the candlestick my brother brought.

mood.ja: 規約の暗唱でも抑えきれない、過去の暗部へ近づく恐怖と静かな興奮。
mood.en: A mixture of fear and quiet excitement as I approach the dark secrets of the past, uncontrollable even by reciting the Code.
